description: This file defines kernel module packages for various input devices in the Linux kernel. It specifies dependencies, configuration options, file locations, and descriptions for modules related to HID, input core, evdev, GPIO keys, joystick, touchscreens, and other input hardware support. The file uses macro-like constructs to register these packages, which are likely processed by a build system for kernel modules.
